tableInfo.name: 指示受け承認情報
tableInfo.sqlForTool: WITH CONVERT_HISTORY AS( select * from sync_convert_history a inner join sync_convert_history_dtl b on (a.seq_no=b.seq_no) where table_kind = 'ORD' ) ,DEAL_DATE AS ( SELECT PATID ,DIALYSIS_DATE ,PLURAL ,MAX(REG_DATE) UPD_DATE ,MIN(REG_DATE) REG_DATE FROM IND_RECEIVE IR WHERE DIALYSIS_DATE >= :START_DATE and DIALYSIS_DATE < :END_DATE {sqlForSync} and DEL_FLG='0' GROUP BY PATID ,DIALYSIS_DATE ,PLURAL ) SELECT IR.PATID ,IR.DIALYSIS_DATE ,IR.PLURAL ,DD.UPD_DATE AS UPD_DATE ,DD.REG_DATE AS REG_DATE ,IR.CHECK_USER1_CD ,IR.CHECK_USER1_TIME ,IR.CHECK_USER2_CD ,IR.CHECK_USER2_TIME ,'{}' as CHECK_CONTENT ,'{}' as APPROVE_CONTENT , 0 as is_content_changed ,( case when (check_user1_time is null) and (check_user2_time is null) then null when (check_user1_time is null) and (check_user2_time is not null) then check_user2_time when (check_user2_time is null) and (check_user1_time is not null) then check_user1_time when (check_user1_time = check_user2_time) then check_user1_time when (check_user1_time < check_user2_time) then check_user2_time when (check_user1_time > check_user2_time) then check_user1_time else null end ) as CHECK_DATE_BASE ,nvl(INPUT_STAFF_NAME1,INPUT_STAFF_NAME2) as INPUT_STAFF_NAME, rst.DIALYSIS_NO FROM ( SELECT a.PATID, a.DIALYSIS_DATE, a.PLURAL, MAX( DECODE( CHECK_CLASS, 1, trim( CHECK_STAFF_CD ) ) ) AS check_user1_cd, MAX( DECODE( CHECK_CLASS, 1, CHECK_DATE ) ) AS check_user1_time, MAX( DECODE( CHECK_CLASS, 2, trim( CHECK_STAFF_CD ) ) ) AS check_user2_cd, MAX( DECODE( CHECK_CLASS, 2, CHECK_DATE ) ) AS check_user2_time, MAX( DECODE( CHECK_CLASS, 1, trim( INPUT_STAFF_NAME ) ) ) AS INPUT_STAFF_NAME1, MAX( DECODE( CHECK_CLASS, 2, trim( INPUT_STAFF_NAME ) ) ) AS INPUT_STAFF_NAME2 FROM IND_RECEIVE a WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM IND_RECEIVE c WHERE a.PATID = c.PATID AND a.DIALYSIS_DATE = c.DIALYSIS_DATE AND a.PLURAL = c.PLURAL AND a.CHECK_CLASS = c.CHECK_CLASS AND a.REG_DATE < c.REG_DATE ) AND a.DIALYSIS_DATE >= :START_DATE and a.DIALYSIS_DATE < :END_DATE {sqlForSync} and a.DEL_FLG='0' GROUP BY a.PATID, a.DIALYSIS_DATE, a.PLURAL ) IR LEFT JOIN DEAL_DATE DD ON IR.PATID = DD.PATID AND IR.DIALYSIS_DATE = DD.DIALYSIS_DATE AND IR.PLURAL = DD.PLURAL LEFT JOIN SCH_DIALYSIS_PLAN plan on IR.PATID||IR.DIALYSIS_DATE||IR.PLURAL = plan.IND_ID LEFT JOIN RST_DIALYSIS rst ON rst.DIALYSIS_NO = plan.RESULT_DIALYSISNO WHERE (plan.RESULT_DIALYSISNO is null or (rst.DIALYSIS_NO = plan.RESULT_DIALYSISNO and plan.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}')) {sqlForExclusiveOutputted}
tableInfo.sqlForExclusiveOutputted: and not exists( select * from CONVERT_HISTORY ch where ch.facility_cd=:facility_cd {sqlForSync} and a.patid=ch.CONVERTTS and to_date(a.DIALYSIS_DATE) >= ch.start_date and to_date(a.DIALYSIS_DATE) < ch.end_date + 1)
